<!-- nativecmpkit-resolution:UI-005:20261028-important-direct -->
## Verified resolution — UTC 2026-10-28
All three original acceptance requirements have been reviewed against source and actual results:

1. Different displayed/selected months, selection changes and null clearing: actual public inline state starts April with March selection, observes real native navigation to May, and retains May through selection change/clear.
2. Save/restore after native month navigation: actual Compose root disposal, sixth-slot Saver restoration and recreated native root retain May independently of March selection. Historical five-element input restores compatibly. The actual Material `DateStateContractTest.saverRetainsDifferentDisplayedMonthAndAcceptsLegacyLists` also passes in the focused desktop run.
3. Compact/wheels/inline: the three exact public native month methods pass in [40716564702](https://github.com/Apdelrahman1911/nativeCmpkit/actions/runs/40716564702) at immutable `71b19242bda60ef0e6346c6b7c5b702d67e4310b`. UIDatePicker has one shown date, not an independently navigable calendar; its owner retains displayed-month intent during actual valueChanged edits and clear rather than inventing unsupported native UI.

Owning fix: additive `displayedMonthMillis`, backend forwarding and visible-month observation, nonanimated programmatic selection with native month preservation, and sixth-slot Saver with legacy-five-slot restore in both Material and iOS implementations. Public packages/methods remain retained.

Reviewed counts: focused desktop **3/3**, one fresh XML, exit 0/51.02 s at immutable `9608ca19896fef3f48bcc8e6e983a7619aa6b77f`; 795 before/after Git inputs held. Native recovery **7 executed, 6 pass, 1 compact replacement appearance failure**, two fresh XML, command exit 1; all 793 Git inputs held. Actual application protocol/XML, worker termination and cleanup agree. All 228 owning UI/core/Gradle main/test/build inputs remain identical to the tested native revision. Closing this individually verified month finding does not represent a whole-workflow pass.
Verification scope: actual iPhone Air/iOS 26.5 simulator, Xcode 26.6 and JDK 17; no physical/minimum-OS, accessibility, heap, ABI, whole-library consumer, dependency/legal/security or release certification. Native endpoint checks exercise the default 1900..2100 range, not every custom year range. The two original failed workflows remain failed; their individual passed cases are reused only after matching owning production/test/helper/build inputs. No successful native cases were replayed. #119/UI-003 remains open for its failed compact appearance assertion. Public Calf packages and original finding/history are preserved. No publication, deployment or subagents.

Important tests → source/results review → direct closure. Detailed evidence is added to the development branch after this closure, not used as a reason to delay it.
